proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: descend to finite type: write S = Spec(A) as a limit of finite type Z-subalgebras, descend f to a finitely presented f_i over S_i, improve it to smooth proper of relative dimension 1, and cut out an open U_i over which the fibres are geometrically connected, replacing X -> S so the Noetherian hypotheses hold; split S by invertibility of l; case (a) l invertible shows the sheaves are finite locally constant via proper base change stalks, finiteness, specialization isomorphisms and the locally constant characterization; case (b) l = p uses that stalks are finite and vanish in degree >= 2, computes f_* of the constant sheaf, and reads R^1 off the Artin-Schreyer sequence as an extension between the cokernel and kernel of Frobenius-minus-one on vector bundles, concluding by the Frobenius-linear constructibility lemma (source lines 4504-4580)

standard_prerequisites.name: Proper base change theorem (Etale Cohomology, Theorem etale-cohomology-theorem-proper-base-change, canonical tag 095T)
standard_prerequisites.use: Base change compatibility of R^qf_* underwrites the split of S into the l invertible and l zero parts, and its stalk form drives both cases.

standard_prerequisites.name: Artin-Schreyer sequence (Etale Cohomology, Section etale-cohomology-section-artin-schreier, canonical tag 0A3J)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the sequence 0 -> Z/pZ -> O_X -> O_X -> 0 from which R^1f_* of the constant sheaf is computed in case (b).

standard_prerequisites.name: Constructibility of Frobenius kernels and cokernels on vector bundles (Lemma lemma-frobenius-linear-on-vb, canonical tag 0GKU)
standard_prerequisites.use: The terminal step of case (b): the short exact sequence exhibits R^1f_* as built from Coker(F - 1) and Ker(F - 1) on locally free sheaves, to which the lemma applies.

core_obligations: Descend to the finite type situation: S affine, write A as a union of finite type Z-subalgebras, find f_i of finite presentation over S_i by the Limits descent lemma, improve it after increasing i to smooth proper of relative dimension 1 by the three Limits lemmas, obtain the open U_i of geometrically connected fibres from More on Morphisms, and replace X -> S (proof lines 4505-4521).

Split by invertibility of l in the Noetherian case: S = U union Z with Z = V(l), and use arbitrary base change compatibility to reduce to case (a) l invertible on S and case (b) l zero on S (proof lines 4524-4532).

Case (a): identify stalks with fibre cohomology by the proper base change stalk lemma and the finiteness theorem, get isomorphic specialization maps from the proper locally constant torsion lemma, and conclude the sheaves are finite locally constant hence constructible by the characterization lemma (proof lines 4535-4549).

Case (b): l = p, stalks finite and zero for q >= 2, f_* of the constant sheaf is constant by the sections-upstairs lemma; form the Artin-Schreyer short exact sequence, use that f_*O_X = O_S and R^1f_*O_X is finite locally free of rank the genus, derive the short exact sequence with Coker(F - 1 : O_S -> O_S) and Ker(F - 1 : R^1f_*O_X -> R^1f_*O_X), and conclude by lemma-frobenius-linear-on-vb (proof lines 4552-4579).
proof_roadmap: Descent to finite type and geometric connectedness open (proof lines 4505-4521).
Split by invertibility of l (proof lines 4524-4532).
Case (a): finite locally constant via specialization isomorphisms (proof lines 4535-4549).
Case (b): Artin-Schreyer computation of R^1 and Frobenius kernels (proof lines 4552-4579).
